cds.title: Texas A&M University-San Antonio Common Data Set 2025-2026 (Excel)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set, first-time, first-year totals (applied 8,936; admitted 8,442 = 3,603 men + 4,839 women; enrolled 1,293). The 2025-26 Common Data Set does not report international applicants or admits, GPA, or SAT/ACT composite percentiles, so those are not shown; the cell for applied-by-sex printed as a spreadsheet error but the totals are given. Undergraduate enrollment is 6,790 ('Total all undergraduates'); the number of international undergraduates is the nonresident count among degree-seeking undergraduates (27). Only 2 of the 1,293 first-year students were nonresidents. No waitlist, no early decision/early action.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set: scores are used in admission and advising (SAT, ACT, AP, CLEP, TSI listed); the admissions site waives them for top 35% / 3.0 GPA applicants.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (first-year, year of the 2025-26 edition): tuition 8,032 in-state and 18,878 out-of-state with required fees reported as 0 (i.e. fees appear to be included); on-campus food and housing 12,070; transportation 1,664 not included. No separate international tuition is printed. Only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 40 nonresidents received it (avg 13,713)
